entities.summary: The Adamic language, according to Jewish tradition and some Christians, is the language spoken by Adam in the Garden of Eden. It is variously interpreted as either the language used by God to address Adam, or the language invented by Adam with which he named all things, as in the second Genesis creation narrative.
